stock.description: United Energy Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the investment and operation of upstream oil, natural gas, clean energy, and energy trading businesses in Pakistan, South Asia, the Middle East, and North Africa. It operates through two segments: Exploration and Production, and Trading. The company is involved in trading of energy products, including petrochemicals; exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas; and construction and operation of solar power generation facility. It also provides administrative and financing support services. United Energy Group Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
